This topic is part of the CCEA GCSE Food Technology specification.

Food Choice appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Food Choice in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Food Choice.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
